$comment: The subset matrix: one entry per case. A case is RUNNABLE when every package it names exists under packages/ and every registry neighbour it declares in requiresInstall can be installed; anything else is reported as 'not yet ported' and counted as neither a pass nor a failure, so the matrix grows as L3/L4/L5 land without the runner being rewritten. `packages` is the JUDGED set (clauses 2 and 3); `requiresInstall` entries are installed into the case's app directory as SUPPORT beside the subject's tarball, and carry a pinned version for the same reason piVersion is pinned — a third party's next release must not move this matrix. PASS is the five clauses in docker/matrix.mjs: zero unexpected load errors, every installed package's entries loaded, each extension's tool set equal to its expected set, exactly one neighbour-absent line per declared absent neighbour (and none naming an installed package), and no register-failed line or undeclared absence line.

What that settles is the LOAD half — the marker changes nothing at load. The activation half lives in fleet's `session_start` handler (`mode.activate`), which the probe never reaches because it opens no session; names missing at activation are reported through `ctx.ui.notify` rather than the diagnostics envelope, so no clause here can observe them. A case that must catch a silent narrowing has to drive a session, not this loader probe.
